identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Replace brittle fixed reload deadlines with configurable convergence

values.goal: Make Runtime-v3 service convergence configurable, generous, stage-specific, and recoverable without weakening service-manager ownership.
values.required_outcome: CSM start, stop, and reload use validated named convergence limits instead of brittle fixed waits, allow slow model-backed startup, and report exact recoverable stage failures.
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 remains lifecycle authority
PR #658 is the stacked dependency base
launchd or systemd remains sole Runtime process owner
operator_constraints: do not introduce tiny test or production timeouts
do not change general API request timeouts
do not restart the live Runtime
work only in the bound FastWork worktree
